command:
set -euo pipefail
changed_files=(${(f)"$(rtk proxy git diff --name-only 951593f7a2ea11db7e14b9154afd46cbbf96f870..HEAD)"})
source_files=(${(f)"$(print -rl -- $changed_files | rtk rg '\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$')"})
format_files=(${(f)"$(print -rl -- $changed_files | rtk rg '\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css|md|ya?ml)$')"})
{
  rtk bunx oxlint $source_files
  rtk bunx oxfmt --check $format_files
  rtk bun run typecheck
  rtk proxy git diff --check 951593f7a2ea11db7e14b9154afd46cbbf96f870..HEAD
} > /tmp/wayland-con-b-exact-static.log 2>&1
